preview_heading: Patriots meet Knight Riders in Kingstown
preview: St Kitts & Nevis Patriots face Trinbago Knight Riders in CPL 2026 Match 2 at Arnos Vale Stadium. The match is scheduled for Sat 8 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The Patriots unite CPL's leading career run-scorer Johnson Charles with Andre Fletcher, while Jason Holder returns to strengthen an experienced Caribbean group. The 2025 champions retain a decorated core led by Sunil Narine, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard and Akeal Hosein as they pursue another title. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
